methodology: The decomposition process involved analyzing both the original research topic and the generated technical specification to extract independent and self-contained atomic units. Each unit was assessed for technical specificity and unambiguity, ensuring that they could be implemented as single requirements. The original research topic was broken down into its core requirements regarding the D flip-flops, reset behavior, and triggering conditions. The generated specification was similarly dissected to identify its components related to the combinational logic, timing behavior, and interface definitions.
mindtraced_atomic_units: D flip-flops must be triggered on the negative edge of the clk signal.
Each DFF should have an active high synchronous reset.
The reset sets the output to 0x34 (00110100 in binary).
The D input is captured on the negative edge of the clk.
The output reflects the D input unless the reset is active.
spec_atomic_units: The module top_module implements 8 D flip-flops (DFFs).
D flip-flops are triggered on the negative edge of the clock signal.
Active high synchronous reset initializes output to 0x34 when reset is activated.
The D input is captured on the negative edge of the clock.
Output q reflects the D input unless reset is active.
When reset is high, output q is set to 8'h34.
If reset is low, output q takes the value of d at the next negative edge of clk.
The critical timing path involves the reset signal and the clk signal.
